projects.name: Solar + Energy Storage on Garage
projects.description: Install 5-7 solar panels on south-facing garage roof face (20x12 ft, ~2-2.8 kW) plus battery storage. Solar = standalone ROI investment (~5yr payback at $0.42/kWh). Battery = generator alternative (no lot space for generator). 30% federal ITC applies to both when paired.
projects.notes: DESIGN: South garage face only. 5 portrait panels = 2.0 kW; 7 mixed = 2.8 kW. ~3,200-4,500 kWh/yr production (20-26% offset). All-in after ITC: solar ~$9-10k, battery ~$9-10k. VENDORS: Sunergy (sunergy.com) — EnergySage 2026 CA Installer of Year, Enphase Platinum, no door-to-door. NRG Clean Power (nrgcleanpower.com) — Diamond Certified, 35yr, San Mateo County, 40yr warranty. Tesla Energy (tesla.com/energy) — online only. AVOID: Sunrun.

tasks.title: Analyze energy usage and size system
tasks.notes: 17,178 kWh/yr at $0.42/kWh avg. Target: 5-7 panels south garage face (20x12 ft) = 2-2.8 kW. ~5yr payback after ITC.

tasks.title: Research and shortlist solar installers
tasks.notes: Shortlist: Sunergy (sunergy.com, Enphase Platinum, no door-to-door), NRG Clean Power (nrgcleanpower.com, Diamond Certified, San Mateo County), Tesla Energy (tesla.com/energy, online only). Avoid Sunrun.

tasks.title: Contact installers for quotes
tasks.notes: Spec: south garage face (20x12 ft, 5-7 panels, ~2-2.8 kW), paired battery (Enphase IQ or Powerwall 3), detached garage sub-panel interconnect. Ask each for: $/W, panel brand, inverter type, battery spec, warranty, timeline, ITC total. Request free shade/LIDAR analysis.

tasks.title: Compare quotes and select installer
tasks.notes: Prefer Enphase microinverters over string inverter. Compare $/W, battery spec, warranty, timeline. 30% ITC on full system incl. battery.

tasks.title: Confirm ITC timing — credit files in year PTO is granted
tasks.notes: 30% federal ITC on Form 5695. Claimed in tax year Permission to Operate granted by PG&E. Battery qualifies only when solar-paired. Plan install timing accordingly.

insights.summary: The sustained count of 20+ connected devices alongside zero camera motion strongly suggests either a large gathering occurring in camera-blind zones or an IoT/network device surge rather than actual people; verifying camera functionality and guest count is recommended.

The sustained presence of 19–24 devices alongside zero camera activity on a Saturday strongly indicates a social gathering or guests are present, likely occupying camera blind spots or with privacy mode enabled. This matters for security awareness and energy management.

The sustained high device count (20–24) combined with zero camera activity on a Saturday morning strongly indicates a large social gathering or family visit. This explains the unusual network load and lack of typical household routines, but you may want to verify if cameras were intentionally disabled for privacy or if the system needs a status check.

The stable high device count (22-24) paired with zero camera activity on a Saturday morning suggests the security cameras may be offline, disabled, or experiencing a network interruption, as typical weekend activity would normally trigger motion detection. This matters because it leaves the home unmonitored while the family is likely awake and moving around.

The increase from 23 to 24 connected devices at 06:40 AM, combined with zero camera activity, indicates a normal Saturday morning wake-up pattern, with the extra device likely being a child or adult powering on a phone or tablet before movement triggers motion detection.

The consistent overnight count of 23-24 connected devices combined with zero camera activity suggests a sleepover or visiting guests are still asleep. This is likely expected for a Saturday morning, but worth noting in case you forgot about visitors or need to prepare for their wake-up routine.
Unusually quiet at whole_home this hour: 0 observations vs typical 2 for weekday 23:00

The sustained 21–23 connected devices alongside zero motion and camera activity indicates active network traffic (streaming, gaming, or background sync) while physical movement has ceased, strongly suggesting the household has transitioned to a settled bedtime routine rather than being unoccupied or experiencing a sensor issue.
Unusually quiet at whole_home this hour: 0 observations vs typical 2 for weekday 22:00

The sustained 20–22 connected devices paired with zero motion and camera activity on a Friday evening strongly indicates the family is home but in a low-activity state, likely gathered in a single room for a movie or gaming session, which is normal weekend downtime.
